question: Do prospective five-on-five lead-HP pairs create a useful attack-versus-switch reversal without erasing previously learned attack choices?

design.contrast: Within each origin, only actor lead HP changes between healthy and 8 HP. Both sides have five members.

new_pair_results.interpretation: The curriculum missed its intended control-decision contrast. These eight examples do not establish HP-sensitive switching.

same_original_44_train_cases.comparison: The new fit regressed on the identical original 44 TRAIN targets; these are not held-out results.

reason: The prospective HP pairs supplied no attack-versus-switch reversal, and the larger fit substantially worsened attack selection on the common TRAIN cases. Keep the older frozen control as authority; neither TRAIN model is promotion-qualified.
